name: TablePulse — secure POS order and agentic deal decision

nodes.name: POS order webhook
nodes.notes: Select a Header Auth credential: x-tablepulse-pos-key. Only the trusted POS/adapter may call this webhook. Publish after testing.

nodes.name: Sign TablePulse request
nodes.notes: Select a Crypto credential with Hmac Secret equal to TABLEPULSE_WEBHOOK_SECRET on the backend. Keep the secret in credentials, never in this workflow.

nodes.name: Record order and evaluate
nodes.notes: Replace the fixed URL with your TablePulse backend. This endpoint BOTH records this new order AND evaluates it. Do not call /api/pos/events first. HTTP errors are classified; only transport/parse errors use node retries.

parameters.content:
## TablePulse · POS to agentic deal decision
1. Select Header Auth on the webhook and Crypto credentials on the signer.
2. Set the fixed HTTPS TablePulse URL in the HTTP node.
3. Send canonical NEW order lines, not the whole cumulative bill.
4. Same externalId + identical order for retries.

TablePulse owns hard rules, fixed margin goals, the optional AI ranker, database, caps, inventory and screen updates. Shown/withheld/control are all successful processing. The workflow is imported inactive and stores no execution payloads by default. See integrations/n8n/README.md.
